notes.blurb: Pale render between a dark frame, upper floors jettied out over the street. Tall and narrow, packed tight, roofs steep and busy.
notes.construction: exposed frame with panels between it, each storey overhanging the one below by a block, no wall run longer than five without a post
notes.ground: a stone footing course of one or two blocks carries the frame clear of the wet
notes.roofs: steep gable (2,1) with deep overhang; dormers where a floor is in the roof
notes.signature: a first-floor oriel carried on brackets over the entrance
